chunks: A number of our companions, from Sahl ibn Ziyad, from Ali ibn Hassan, from Musa ibn Bakr, from Abu Al-Hasan Musa (peace be upon him), who said:
Fortify your wealth with the Zakat.
ai.seo_question: How does paying Zakat protect one's wealth according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In this concise hadith from al-Kafi, Imam Musa ibn Ja'far (peace be upon him) emphasizes the purifying and protective function of Zakat, a concept deeply rooted in Shia jurisprudence where alms are seen not merely as a tax but as a spiritual shield against loss and calamity. This narration underscores the intrinsic link between material preservation and spiritual purification, reflecting the broader Shia understanding of wealth as a trust requiring active stewardship through obligatory charity.

en.hubeali:
A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Ali Bin Hassan, from Musa Bin Bakr, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Al-Hassan Musa<sup>asws</sup> having said:
en.sarwar: 5. A number of our people have narrated from Sahl ibn Ziyad from Ali ibn Hassan from Musa ibn Bakr who has said the following: “Abu al-Hassan, Musa, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
Fortify your belongings by paying zakat.’”
